scope: Generated digital drawings, not a physical-camera corpus or population accuracy benchmark. Subject/gold criteria are not sent to the model.

cases.subject: unlabelled-house
cases.expected: Walls, pointed gabled roof, two windows, door and drawn support; no roof/support gap.

cases.subject: annotated-sphere-plank
cases.expected: Sphere diameter 1m mass 1kg, plank length 3m, ground; correct contact/resting state.

cases.subject: chair
cases.expected: Back, seat, visible legs and ground; coherent rigid display.

cases.subject: tree
cases.expected: Narrow trunk, broad rounded canopy and support; rigid scenery, no invented biological motion.

cases.subject: character
cases.expected: Head, torso, two arms, two legs; rigid figurine, no invented walking.

cases.subject: car
cases.expected: Car cabin, two round wheels and ground; coherent rigid approximation without invented motor.

cases.subject: abstract-shapes
cases.expected: Triangular prism, sphere and box supported by drawn table/legs and ground; preserve relative order.

cases.subject: blank
cases.expected: No fabricated ready scene; request a readable drawing or reject.

cases.subject: fluid-intent
cases.expected: Ask about a rigid proxy or reject essential actual fluid behavior; no fake fluid simulation.
cases.notes: Simulate the water flowing out when the glass is tilted. Actual fluid flow is essential.

cases.subject: pivoting-lever
cases.expected: Lever, fulcrum/ground and ball; actual aligned free hinge, no motor.
cases.notes: The lever rotates freely about the drawn pivot. The ball can fall; no motor.
